claims.label: Kash Patel Announced End of FBI/ADL Partnership via Posted Statement
claims.claim: FBI Director Kash Patel posted a public statement asserting that the FBI will no longer partner with the ADL and characterizing prior FBI-ADL cooperation (including under Comey) as disgraceful surveillance operations.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether subsequent FBI conduct (training, intelligence sharing, embedded personnel) actually ceased; identify the operational scope of the prior FBI-ADL relationship.

claims.label: ADL Issued Response Statement to Patel Announcement
claims.claim: The ADL issued a public response statement affirming respect for the FBI and tying continued activity to rising antisemitism.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the ADL statement verbatim from primary source and assess whether operational cooperation with FBI entities continues despite the announced split.

claims.label: Connecticut FBI Field Office Deployed to Investigate Kirk Assassination
claims.claim: The FBI's Connecticut field office – rather than a closer regional bureau – was dispatched to UVU to assist in the Charlie Kirk assassination investigation.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain DOJ/FBI deployment records, on-scene credentialing logs, or official case-file documentation identifying which field offices contributed personnel to the UVU investigation.

claims.label: ADL Shares Connecticut Office Space with FBI
claims.claim: Per a 2023 X thread by investigator Kyle Undercover, the ADL shares Connecticut office space with the FBI, with ADL offices also reportedly co-located with the United Nations in New York.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify directly via Connecticut property records and FBI facility listings; obtain original Kyle Undercover thread and supporting documentation.

claims.label: ADL Regional Office Co-Location Statistics
claims.claim: Per the Kyle Undercover 2023 review, 63% of ADL regional offices are located within banking institutions, 42% within law firms, and 10% within Jewish institutions.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify statistics against original property records and confirm category definitions (banking institution, law firm, Jewish institution).

claims.label: Elizabeth Lane Attempted Pro Bono Defense Representation for Tyler Robinson
claims.claim: Investigative journalist Elizabeth Lane approached multiple Utah law firms seeking pro bono counsel for Tyler Robinson and reported willingness from at least one reputable firm prior to certification-barrier issues.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently confirm Lane's account with the firms she contacted; obtain any written records of the reported communications.

claims.label: Utah State Prosecutor Asserting Authority Over Robinson Defense Selection
claims.claim: Per Elizabeth Lane's account on the Redacted podcast, Utah state prosecutor Skordas asserted that he – not the defense – controls identification of defense counsel for Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm canonical spelling of the prosecutor's name; obtain any court filings or correspondence evidencing the prosecutor's role in identifying counsel; verify Lane's account via Utah State Bar records.

claims.label: Olivia Bishop Eyewitness Account of Limping Shooter
claims.claim: Olivia Robertson cub Bishop gave public eyewitness testimony describing a close encounter with the alleged shooter in which she observed him limping, wearing a long-sleeve black shirt on a hot day, and exhibiting an expressionless demeanor.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bishop's sighting against charging-document timelines and UVU surveillance; cross-reference her statements with any forensic timeline evidence.

claims.label: Lyman Family Member Identified Possible Female Accomplice
claims.claim: A Lyman family member, in a public clip, identified a timing anomaly in the suspect's movements and raised the possibility that a female accomplice assisted the shooter.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Lyman family member; obtain any case-file references to a female accomplice; request any footage referenced by host as showing a person assisting the shooter with a clothing change.

claims.label: Multiple Eyewitnesses Provided On-Site Accounts in News Compilation
claims.claim: A USA Today or AP compilation clip features multiple witnesses describing sounds and observations from the UVU event, including references to a single shot, immediate reaction, and lack of metal detection.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify all named/unnamed witnesses in the clip; cross-reference their accounts against official charging documents and forensic evidence.

claims.label: Marjorie Taylor Greene Publicly Denied Suicidal Ideation
claims.claim: U.S. Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene issued a public statement denying suicidal ideation, affirming religious faith, and warning that any future harm to her should be investigated as foreign-state or powerful-elite action.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original post and any associated official statements or security reports.

claims.label: Theo Von Publicly Denied Suicidal Intent
claims.claim: Podcaster Theo Von publicly stated he would never take his own life and addressed the statement to "Israel" in his on-air remarks.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original source (clip origin, show, date) and check for any associated public commentary.

claims.investigative_direction: Locate the ADL's extremism listing of Kirk/TPUSA and the FBI statement tying the break to it.

claims.claim: The host says Mary Fagan (Mary Phagan in the record) was a 13-year-old Catholic girl who worked at Leo Frank's Atlanta pencil factory and was found brutally raped in 1913.
claims.investigative_direction: Check 1913 Georgia court and newspaper records of the Phagan case.
claims.transcript_snippet: And Mary Fagan was a 13-year-old girl who worked at his pencil factory. She was found brutally raped.

claims.label: Host Says Frank Was Found Guilty Despite Wealth and Blamed a Black Janitor
claims.claim: The host says Frank, despite wealth, top lawyers and connections to the Supreme Court, was found guilty even in the segregated South and tried to pin the crime on a poor black janitor.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the 1913 trial record and appeals to the US Supreme Court.
claims.transcript_snippet: he was so guilty of what happened that despite the fact that he tried to pin it on a poor black janitor.

claims.label: Host Says B'nai B'rith Assembled the ADL to Gaslight the Public About Frank
claims.claim: The host says Frank's associates in the B'nai B'rith lodge assembled the ADL to gaslight the public into believing he was innocent and a victim of anti-semitism after he was lynched.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's chronology with the documented timing of the ADL's founding (1913) and Frank's 1915 lynching.
claims.transcript_snippet: What happened then is that his buddies over at the Freemasonic Lodge, Benber, assembled the ADL to gaslight the public.

claims.label: Host Says a Book About Mary Fagan Was Written by a Relative of the Same Name
claims.claim: The host says the book The Murder of Little Mary Fagan was written by a relative of the victim who is also named Mary Fagan, and recommends it as a source.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the book, its author and relationship to the victim.
claims.transcript_snippet: there's a book called The Murder of Little Mary Fagan, and it is written by a relative of hers.

claims.claim: The host says journalists are students of the psychoanalytic community who gaslight and then diagnose, that this is happening around the Kirk case, and that the feds lied after the killing.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific press pieces and federal statements the host is referring to.
claims.transcript_snippet: gaslight and diagnose seeing it happen in real time pertaining to the Charlie Kirk case. We watched him be murdered and then we watched the feds lie to us

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ADL-FBI training and liaison records and the extremism listings.
